data.one_liner: An animated bottom tab bar inspired by Cuberto.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable bottom navigation bar with animated tab selection. It allows displaying icons and titles with smooth transition effects.
use_when: You need an animated bottom navigation bar for your app.
You want to replicate the Cuberto-style tab bar UI.
avoid_when: You require standard Material Design bottom navigation without custom animations.
strengths: Provides built-in smooth animations for tab selection.
weaknesses: Limited to bottom navigation bar usage.
Very specific design style may not fit all apps.
